data.one_liner: Widget that creates dynamic aura backgrounds based on image colors
data.what_it_does: AdaptiveAuraContainer extracts colors from an image and renders a customizable aura effect behind its child. It supports gradient, blob, and sunray styles with adjustable animation, blur, and intensity.
use_when: You need a visually appealing background that adapts to image colors
Building a music player or image gallery with dynamic themes
Prototyping UI concepts that require animated background effects
avoid_when: You need maximum performance with minimal GPU usage
Your app already uses a heavy animation framework and cannot afford extra rendering
strengths: Three distinct aura styles with many customization options
Smooth transitions and low impact on UI responsiveness
weaknesses: No unit or integration tests documented
No support for custom color palettes beyond the provided API
data.minimal_example:
AdaptiveAuraContainer(
  image: AssetImage('assets/images/album.jpg'),
  auraStyle: AuraStyle.blob,
  child: YourContentWidget(),
)
